mapper.select: SELECT client_id, party_id, status FROM t_client WHERE client_id = #{clientId} ORDER BY client_id
mapper.update: UPDATE t_client SET status='ACTIVE', activation_time=COALESCE(activation_time, #{now}), update_time=#{now} WHERE client_id=#{clientId} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE t_client SET status='SUSPENDED', suspension_time=#{now}, update_time=#{now} WHERE client_id=#{clientId} AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.sql: (SELECT NULLIF(COALESCE(o.legal_name, TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', i.given_name, i.middle_name, i.family_name))), '') FROM t_party_profile pp LEFT JOIN t_organization_profile o ON o.profile_id = pp.profile_id LEFT JOIN t_individual_profile i ON i.profile_id = pp.profile_id WHERE pp.party_id = ${partyColumn} AND pp.current_slot = 1)
mapper.select: SELECT c.client_id AS clientId, c.client_no AS clientNo, c.party_id AS partyId, pt.party_type AS clientType, c.status AS status, AS legalName FROM t_client c JOIN t_party pt ON pt.party_id = c.party_id WHERE c.client_id = #{clientId}

SELECT c.client_id AS clientId, c.client_no AS clientNo, pt.party_type AS clientType, c.status AS status, c.jurisdiction_code AS jurisdictionCode, c.responsible_partner_id AS responsiblePartnerId, AS legalName, (SELECT a.application_id FROM t_client_application a WHERE a.client_id = c.client_id ORDER BY a.application_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS latestApplicationId, (SELECT a.status FROM t_client_application a WHERE a.client_id = c.client_id ORDER BY a.application_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS latestApplicationStatus, c.create_time AS createTime
ORDER BY c.client_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT c.client_id AS clientId, c.client_no AS clientNo, pt.party_type AS clientType, c.status AS status, c.jurisdiction_code AS jurisdictionCode, c.responsible_partner_id AS responsiblePartnerId, AS legalName, (SELECT a.application_id FROM t_client_application a WHERE a.client_id = c.client_id ORDER BY a.application_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS latestApplicationId, (SELECT a.status FROM t_client_application a WHERE a.client_id = c.client_id ORDER BY a.application_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS latestApplicationStatus, c.create_time AS createTime FROM t_client c JOIN t_party pt ON pt.party_id = c.party_id WHERE c.client_id = #{clientId}
